description: Found by dfparity-t21 (evidence: /Users/joe/.jcode/scratch/dfparity-handoff/evidence/rev3/t21_tpch_findings.md, develop 964bea289). Independently spot-checked on the SF=1 DuckDB database for Q3, Q11, Q18 and Q20: the official answer files (_sources/tpc-h/dbgen/answers/) match `qgen -d` exactly (Q11 1048 rows, Q18 57, Q20 186). `qgen -r 17039360` gives 1469, 9 and 188 rows and different Q3 values. Findings: (1) TPCH_SF1_REFERENCE_SEED (benchmark.py ~31-47) is not the answer-file parameter set, so seeded SQL power runs at SF 1 report false row-count failures on Q11, Q16, Q18 and Q20, and the comments in benchmark.py, tpch_results.py and power_test.py ~317 are wrong. (2) Seeded DataFrame runs ignore the seed: set_parameter_overrides is never called, and they bind the -d defaults. _tpch_reference_context then labels them answer-file-valid. SQL and DataFrame parameters differ on 22 of 22 queries at seed 17039360. (3) In throughput runs, SQL derives a seed per stream and position, and unseeded throughput uses base seed 42 while the power test uses -d. DataFrame streams only reorder the -d queries, so bindings differ at 65 of 66 positions. The DataFrame path also ignores --streams. (4) The SQL bundle reports PASSED although its warm-up stream validation failed 4 checks. (5) The parameter extractor silently returns defaults on dialect-translated SQL, so extract from raw qgen text only.
